findings.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
findings.disposition_evidence: Same reachability class as the registered sibling advisory on this exact package and version set, GHSA-grv7-fg5c-xmjg (2026-09-23 register: 'micromatch dependency in the build toolchain ... consumed by one-shot esbuild/vite production bundle over repository-owned source; no runtime import path'). The stack-exhaustion impact requires an untrusted pattern string to reach braces.expand() in an executed Node process; the require-inventory trace of the executed Node surface established for the same family in the 2026-09-30-2 delta (GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p, brace-expansion) covers it: the frappe@988e54f3 realtime server and every shipped runtime Node file import zero of glob/minimatch/braces/brace-expansion/micromatch, and the owners (frappe stylus->glob@7->minimatch@3->braces@3.0.2; education frontend sucrase->glob@10->minimatch@9->braces@3.0.3; hrms rimraf/workbox-build/eslint/jake) run exclusively at build/lint time on the builder's machine against tool-internal patterns. Availability-only, and absent from the runtime surface even within its own domain.

findings.title: PostCSS: Quadratic complexity in flat selector parsing allows CPU exhaustion
findings.disposition_evidence: Advisory impact (GitHub Advisory API): 'Only consumers that parse untrusted, attacker-supplied selectors synchronously in a request path are exposed ... Ordinary build-time use on trusted sources is not affected.' Consumers in the pinned trees are build tooling over repository-owned CSS: education/frontend tailwindcss 3.4.1 and @tailwindcss/typography 0.5.10 (via frappe-ui) run inside the one-shot vite build; frappe's 6.0.13 comes only through @vue/component-compiler-utils (ROOT -> @vue/component-compiler -> @vue/component-compiler-utils). Session-1 evidence, not re-run: a full-tree grep of frappe@988e54f3 found no source reference to @vue/component-compiler or its utils (the package.json entry alone). No runtime Node file (frappe/realtime requires socket.io, node:http, fs, path and local modules) or Python path imports the parser. Not gated: the HRMS trees also carry postcss-selector-parser 6.0.10/6.0.13/6.1.2 (frontend) and 6.0.10/6.1.0 (roster); their build-time consumers are not verified (README section 7, coverage gap).
